Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 5 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, please share your update. What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment that the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being paused until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, and I will add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
For bug 12, with the sandbox gateway timing out and you needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

I’ve noted your commitment that Daniel can help and you’ll pair with him on the staging access today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted you finished the refund API tests, you’re continuing the payment retry story today, and there are no blockers.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the sandbox being down and blocking that work, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker waiting on the sandbox from the platform team and your commitment to sync with Maya after stand-up, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page will be picked back up once idempotency keys are in; settlement file validation is blocked on bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and a need for access to the platform team’s staging gateway; the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review; and work was impacted by the sandbox being down while waiting on the platform team. A side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration checks was parked for offline follow-up. Flagged items nobody covered: task 15, which is stale, and its owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thank you, everyone.
